content:
OpenAI launches ChatGPT for teens. The company describes the new initiative as "an experience designed to help teens learn, think critically, deepen their understanding, and use AI with confidence." ChatGPT for teens is activated when OpenAI's system estimates a user is between the ages of 13 and 17, or when a user directly states their age.

OpenAI highlights four features launching alongside ChatGPT for teens:

  • Study Mode helps teens master what they're learning through guided questions and step-by-step support.
  • A new responsible homework helper that can identify when teens appear to be looking for shortcuts to complete assignments and steer them to Study Mode for step-by-step, collaborative problem solving.
  • Quizzing and study visualisation that gives teens more ways to practise, test what they know, and make tricky concepts clearer to check their understanding.
  • Also, a new Study Hours feature lets teens or parents schedule when Study Mode automatically turns on, making it easier to turn good study habits into a routine.

Additionally, ChatGPT for teens includes the following safety guardrails:

For teen users, safety is built in by default. For users under 18, ChatGPT for teens applies age-appropriate protections designed to reduce exposure to potentially harmful or developmentally inappropriate content while preserving the ability to learn, create, and explore. […] This work also builds on family tools we've previously launched, such as parental controls and notifications. Parents who have linked teen accounts can set quiet hours, manage some settings, and receive safety notifications in limited, high-risk situations. We're adding notifications related to eating disorders, alongside limiting what content is shared and focusing on moments when offline support matters most.

OpenAI also detailed how ChatGPT operates for users under 18, including the following wellness measures:

  • Sensitive image upload nudges that encourage teens not to share private or sensitive images.
  • A teen-specific onboarding tour that introduces them to the learning and safety features available right from the start.
  • Simple personalisation options, like theme colour and voice variations, that help make the experience feel personal without blurring the line between a useful tool and a relationship.
